_doc: PROPOSAL (task M3-01, second run), not game data. Apprentice robots and the chain that builds them (spec sections 3 and 14, decisions 16.1, 16.3 and 16.5): the crew climbs from 1 robot at about player minute 20 to 100-200 at the launch point. Robots EARN NO CUBES: they restore the city, Scroungers bring in Parts, haulers carry Lumi's bales. Robots and their upgrades cost PARTS only. mastery_speed: a robot works a kind at rate x (base + per_level x Lumi's mastery of that kind), and not at all below min_level, so Lumi's hands set the pace of the whole crew. near_bonus: extra speed for crew in the district Lumi is in. distance: a robot works shift_s seconds between trips to its base and a trip costs s_per_ring seconds for every ring out, so its speed at ring r is shift_s / (shift_s + s_per_ring x r); the simulator averages that over a city's hexes (a few percent in city 1, about a tenth in city 6) and uses it for the whole planet, where it is what makes outposts worth building. crew_cap: most robots in all at base level 1..6 (buildings do not count). chain: scrounger and assembler name the two types of the chain. Every hex that gets cleaned leaves buried parts in the ground (districts.json buried_parts_per_hex); a Scrounger carries `carry` of them to the base per round trip of trip_s + trip_s_per_ring x the district's rings seconds, from the open district with the most left, and when the ground is empty it carries nothing: crew growth follows cleaning. hand_dig_s: seconds Lumi takes to dig one buried part herself when there is nothing else to do (so Parts cannot lock up a player with few Scroungers). The Assembler is a factory BUILDING at the base (building: true, max 1 on this planet, no upgrade here: the faster line and the second line are left for the long goal): it turns Parts into one robot every assembly_s seconds, in the mix the player sets, and its line is what paces the crew's growth from city 3 on; a rocket part on the line takes its place until done. Through cities 1 and 2 Lumi builds every robot by hand at the bench; after the Assembler stands only the first robot of a type is hand-built. haul_share: share of Lumi's bale carrying one hauler takes over. Tiers on Planet 1: rusty and repaired, per robot TYPE: repaired_mult = a repaired type's speed (work or carrying); the upgrade costs the type's repair_parts plus repair_per_robot x its build price for each robot already owned; robots of a repaired type cost repaired_build_mult x as much to build; repair_requires = the id that opens upgrades; no_repair = the type has no upgrade on this planet. types: kinds = pollution kinds the type can work; rate = units a second per rusty robot at speed 1.0; water_rate / plant_rate = hexes a second a tender waters or plants (planting uses seeds); hauls = carries Lumi's bales; parts = Parts to build one; max = most of that type; requires = id that must be owned; district = index of the district that must be open. The Drip (city 4) waters and mists smog; the Seedling (city 5) plants and sets cleansing plants on blight. Base levels also raise crew speed (upgrades.json base_N mods).
